Colorbars.summary: Color bars control: four horizontal bars adjust the RGBA components and a swatch on the right previews the color. Inherits from Control.

props.color: Current color {r,g,b,a} with 0-1 components; default white {1,1,1,1}
props.OnChange: Event table invoked when the color changes, with the new color table as argument

Colorbars:SetColor.desc: Fires OnChange, stores the given color in value and invalidates (it does not modify the color field itself).

Colorbars:DrawControl.desc: Draws the four R/G/B/A component bars, the current-color swatch on the right and the border.

Colorbars:HitTest.desc: Always returns self, so the whole control responds to clicks.

Colorbars:MouseDown.desc: Determines which component bar was clicked, writes that color component and calls SetColor.

Colorbars:MouseMove.desc: While dragging with the left button held, reuses MouseDown for continuous color editing.

params.button: 1 means dragging with the left button

fileDesc: Color bars control: four horizontal bars adjust the RGBA components and a swatch on the right previews the current color.
